read_only: command -v systemctl && command -v journalctl && command -v timeout
notes: Require a Linux host actually running systemd; an installed CLI alone does not prove the system bus is available.
After the user identifies a unit, read its state with systemctl --no-pager show --property=Id,ActiveState,SubState,Result,ExecMainStatus UNIT.
Read finite logs with timeout 15s journalctl --no-pager -u UNIT -n 100 --since '15 minutes ago' -o short-iso 2>&1 | head -c 32768; quote the confirmed unit safely.
A failed state is not a root cause. Inspect exit status and timestamps before concluding.
Never restart, stop, enable, disable, daemon-reload, edit units, or vacuum the journal without explicit authorization. Logs may contain secrets; redact before sharing.
